m.d: A button on a machine that ejects something from the machine.
m.e: When the DVD is finished, press eject.

m.d: To eject can mean to force (a person or people) to leave.
m.e: The man started a fight and was ejected from the bar.

m.d: To be ejected can also mean to be thrown out of something quickly.
m.e: A man from Montreal was ejected from his car because he was in an accident.

m.d: To eject someone can mean to make (a sports player) leave the field because they are behaving in a bad way.
